whenToUse: Texts of varying length, such as property introductions, product descriptions, or reviews.
Heights need to line up in cards or lists.
Reading the beginning is enough for most people.
whenNotToUse: Terms or warnings that must be read (show them in full from the start).
Texts of only a few lines.
A long answer under a single title (use a disclosure or an accordion).

alternatives.name: Disclosure
alternatives.reason: Opening content by pressing a title.

accessibility: The button appears only when the text actually overflows, and connects to it with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
The button comes right after the text, so focus continues from the same place after expanding.
The shortened text is all in the DOM, so screen readers can read the whole thing.
When the screen size changes, measure again to show or hide the button.
